title: My Experience as a Research Intern at IIT Gandhinagar
description: Reflections on my research internship experience at IIT Gandhinagar, working on thermal imaging and AI-driven healthcare solutions.
content:
## Research Internship at IIT Gandhinagar

Working at IIT Gandhinagar has been a transformative experience. I joined the lab under **Prof. Nipun Batra** to work on thermal imaging-based respiration monitoring.

### Key Takeaways

- Learned to work with **thermal cameras** and infrared imaging
- Developed skills in **YOLO-based object detection** for nostril tracking
- Gained experience with **signal processing** for breathing rate extraction
- Collaborated with a multidisciplinary team of researchers

### Technical Challenges

The biggest challenge was dealing with noisy thermal data and ensuring robust detection across different sleeping positions. We addressed this through:

1. Data augmentation techniques
2. Multi-scale feature extraction
3. Temporal smoothing algorithms

> Research is the process of going up alleys to see if they are blind. — Marston Bates
